_about: Outside connections: the highway stubs at the map edge where people and goods will arrive. Lengths are metres, slopes rise over run. `count` is how many a map gets, chosen from the seed between `min` and `max`. Candidates sit every `candidateStep` along each side, no closer than `cornerMargin` to a corner. A candidate's whole stub must be dry, at least `minHeightAboveWater` above the water, and no steeper than `maxSlope` anywhere along it. Two connections are at least `minSpacing` apart. `clearance` is how far a stub keeps from roads already built, which only matters when an old save gains its connections. No prices here, so no source years. Starting values to tune.
